name: CONTENT-RUNTIME-AUTH
status: implemented in content; local fixture verification only; integration pending

runtime.management: separate loopback port; expose health only
runtime.readiness: database connection and authoritative session Redis GET must succeed
runtime.schema: automatic SQL, Flyway and Liquibase disabled by default
runtime.redis: TLS required, configure trusted CA with JVM truststore; standalone host and port; username restricted to GET on session key namespace
runtime.readTimeout: 800ms reactive timeout, 1000ms blocking upper bound; no positive cache
runtime.publicKey: single configured kid and X.509 RSA public key file, minimum 2048 bits; rotation requires coordinated restart
runtime.startup: required auth and DB settings, public key and TLS must be valid or startup fails

auth.routes: all application routes protected by default; blog or admin scope selected from path; health endpoint exempt
auth.errors: HTTP 401/business 401 invalid token/session; HTTP 403/business 403 scope; HTTP 503/business 500 unavailable or malformed session state
auth.authorization: scope is not authorization for administrative actions; future business controllers must enforce object ownership and separately approved admin permissions

build.rootIntegration: controller to request infra add <module>knode-content</module> to root pom.xml

notImplemented: public article lists and details; backend HTTP and admin permissions
production event relay and consumer integration
verification: loopback HTTP with signed synthetic RSA keys and session substitute; H2 and mocked Redis reader checks. Not a real User/Redis/MySQL integration.
articleSlice: Blog POST uses verified principal; internal command service enforces ownership for edit/status/delete. Local transaction and immutable fact inserts implemented; no other article HTTP endpoint.
